page_sections_raw.Planar Focus sets:
== Planar Focus sets ==
The trinkets for these sets drop from quests in [[The Demonweb]] Adventure Pack. The relic weapons drop from the [[Caught in the Web]] raid.

Trinkets each have random ability bonus, making it effectively a choice from 6 items.

Relic weapons must first be upgraded to '''[[Planar Conflux]]''' weapons by acquiring 3 [[Commendation of Heroism]] and 375 [[Purple Dragon Knights]] favor and speaking to Mikrom Sum, the [[Purple Dragon Knights]] favor vendor in [[Eveningstar]]. More information on PDK favor upgrades {{Forums|381612|here}}.
